title: Consolidate Monorepo Into Single Files
description: Consolidate monorepo source into single files where frameworks allow. Keep required separate entry points (Vite main.ts, package.json subpath exports for puzzle plays, vitest/playwright configs). Merge playground core index+core, renderer boot into index, fold lint.script.ts into script.ts where present. Update imports and package exports. Run tests.
summary: Fixed dev:lowpoly white/black screen after plugin-registry merge into framework/product/os/dev/js/index.ts. Root cause: boot code used `await import("./index.ts")` (self-import) while module evaluation was still suspended at top-level await — browser never finished boot, leaving #root empty. Fix: moved PLUGIN_BUILD_TARGETS region before boot, removed self-import, inlined `plugins` array from registry exports. Verified with Playwright on port 6288 — lowpoly shell, 3D viewport, document and tool panels all render. Updated consolidate-ts-modules.ts to avoid self-import regression on future merges.
